bundle.shortDescription: Play sounds through a virtual microphone in Discord
bundle.longDescription: Wagmify mixes sound effects and music into a virtual microphone so Discord hears them as your voice, while your real microphone is mixed in so you can keep talking. Library, hotkey pads, a timeline arranger and file/video/link import.
